name: EconovaChain
description: ECNOVA is the token of the EconovaChain ecosystem on Solana. The ecosystem brings together the ECNOVA Wallet, TimeLayer — a network for verifiable digital receipts — and Scalp, a social network for traders. EconovaChain develops tools for managing digital assets, analyzing markets, and independently verifying the integrity of digital records, including those used in AI agent workflows.
